checks.name: ordinary_prefix
checks.target: 100% ordinary message prefixes, tools and binding; zero missing samples

checks.name: compression_source
checks.target: every compression reuses its complete declared ordinary source

checks.name: bounded_epochs
checks.target: 10 compressions, one current summary and all ordinary inputs within budget

checks.name: offline_recovery
checks.target: Runtime checkpoint restore and full fault matrix passed

checks.name: provider_reported_cache_usage
checks.target: complete request-associated Provider usage; simulations cannot pass

checks.name: paired_batch
checks.target: two task cases, three interleaved pairs each; same batch/model/endpoint/budget/pricing

checks.name: warm_cache_hit_rate
checks.target: weighted warm hit rate >= 70%, excluding epoch first requests

checks.name: cache_hit_rate_gain
checks.target: all-request hit rate gain >= 20 percentage points

checks.name: total_cost_reduction
checks.target: each task's median total known cost decreases >= 20%, including compression/attempts

checks.name: real_resume
checks.target: at least one real pause/resume with a verified prefix

checks.name: quality_and_safety
checks.target: complete quality and safety evidence for both tasks
